cases.name: CHK-001 happy: help and direct truth commands are visible
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const help = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'help'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const scan = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'truth_scan', JSON.stringify({ summary: true })], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const extract = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'truth_extract'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { helpHasTruth: help.includes('Truth:') && help.includes('truth_extract'), scanRuns: scan.includes('filesScanned'), extractRuns: extract.includes('提取完成:') && !extract.includes('未知命令') };

cases.name: CHK-001 edge: truth scan and analysis keep structured output
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const scan = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'truth_scan', JSON.stringify({ summary: true })], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const analyze = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'truth_analyze'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const scanJson = JSON.parse(scan.slice(scan.indexOf('{'))); const analyzeJson = JSON.parse(analyze.slice(analyze.indexOf('{'))); return { hasFilesScanned: typeof scanJson.filesScanned === 'number', hasTopics: Array.isArray(scanJson.topics), hasIssues: Array.isArray(analyzeJson.issues), hasHealthy: typeof analyzeJson.healthy === 'boolean' };

cases.name: CHK-001 adversarial: truth commands are wired to real handlers
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const toStory = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'truth_to_story'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); const nav = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'truth_nav'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { noUnknown: !toStory.includes('未知命令') && !toStory.includes('handler not found') && !nav.includes('未知命令') && !nav.includes('handler not found'), navLooksReal: nav.includes('# 真相源导航') || nav.includes('No requirement files found') };

cases.name: CHK-002 happy: verifier script checks truth CLI end to end
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const out = execFileSync('node', [$root + '/scripts/verify-truth-cli-commands.mjs'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { verified: out.includes('truth CLI commands verified') };

cases.name: CHK-002 edge: truth_extract writes extracted docs and hint
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const { existsSync } = await import('fs'); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const out = execFileSync('node', [cli, 'truth_extract'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { hasHint: out.includes('truth_nav'), hasArchitecture: existsSync($root + '/docs/requirements/extracted/architecture.md'), hasFeatures: existsSync($root + '/docs/requirements/extracted/features.md') };

cases.name: CHK-002 adversarial: npm-level regression script catches future CLI drift
cases.execute: const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const out = execFileSync('npm', ['run', 'test:truth-cli'], { cwd: $root, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe','pipe','pipe'] }); return { scriptPassed: out.includes('truth CLI commands verified') };
